Analytical Steady States

Source: R/steadyStates.R
steadyStates.Rd

Computes symbolic steady-state expressions for use in a parameter transformation, following the AlyssaPetit method [1], [2]. States whose own balance gives a ratio of positive sums are solved from it first. The cycles of the graph of states left are cut then: at a state of a conserved quantity, or at a state whose balance is solved for a rate constant of one flux side instead. Each cut state stays a free parameter. The remaining states and the rate constants of the cuts are then solved, each from a balance or a combination of balances in amounts, such that the result is a ratio of sums of positive terms. Only if that fails, a flux side with separate rate constants is cut as well: the fluxes of the side keep free ratios, the new parameters r_<state>_<j>. Compartment volumes are fixed. The solver is a Python module called through reticulate; it needs numpy, sympy and scipy.

Usage

steadyStates(
  model,
  file = NULL,
  forcings = NULL,
  givenCQs = NULL,
  neglect = NULL,
  testSteady = c("fast", "skip"),
  walltime = 0L,
  simplify = TRUE,
  solveQuadratic = FALSE,
  priority = NULL,
  resolve = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

model

An eqnlist, or the path of a csv file describing the model.

file

Character, path of the RDS file the result is written to with saveRDS(). For an eqnlist the model is also written to <file>_model.csv for the solver. Default NULL writes nothing; the solver then reads the model from a temporary file.

forcings

Character vector, names of forcings. These states are held at zero and treated as exogenous. Default NULL.

givenCQs

Unnamed character vector of conserved quantities, either as c("A + pA = totA", "B + pB = totB") or as c("A + pA", "B + pB"). Default NULL: a basis is derived, or taken from customTotals() when the eqnlist has them. Each given quantity keeps one of the states in it free, the first one on a cycle of the graph of states.

neglect

Character vector, states and rate parameters the solver must not solve for. Default NULL.

testSteady

How the solution is verified: "fast" (default), a probabilistic check modulo a prime, or "skip".

walltime

Integer, time budget of the solver in seconds, 0 (default) for none.

simplify

TRUE (default) simplifies every expression once with sympy, FALSE skips it, "full" simplifies further at a higher cost.

solveQuadratic

Logical, whether the balance of a state, when quadratic in that state, may be solved for the positive root instead of for a rate constant, which introduces sqrt() terms. Default FALSE.

priority

Character vector of state and rate-parameter names, most preferred first: named states are solved rather than kept free and solved earlier, named rate parameters are preferred as pivots. Default NULL.

resolve

Logical, whether the result is passed through resolveRecurrence() so that no equation refers to another. Default TRUE.

verbose

TRUE reports progress in a few lines and the result, FALSE (default) only the result, "full" every step of the solver.

Value

Named character vector of steady-state equations in dMod format, or 0 if no solution was found. An entry whose value equals the entry name is a free parameter.

References

[1] Rosenblatt, M., Timmer, J. and Kaschek, D. (2016). Customized steady-state constraints for parameter estimation in non-linear ordinary differential equation models. Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology 4, 41. doi:10.3389/fcell.2016.00041

[2] https://github.com/marcusrosenblatt/AlyssaPetit

See also

repar(), P()

Examples

reactions <- eqnlist()
reactions <- addReaction(reactions, "Tca_buffer", "Tca_cyto",
                         "import_Tca*Tca_buffer", "Basolateral uptake")
reactions <- addReaction(reactions, "Tca_cyto", "Tca_buffer",
                         "export_Tca_baso*Tca_cyto", "Basolateral efflux")
reactions <- addReaction(reactions, "Tca_cyto", "Tca_canalicular",
                         "export_Tca_cana*Tca_cyto", "Canalicular efflux")
reactions <- addReaction(reactions, "Tca_canalicular", "Tca_buffer",
                         "transport_Tca*Tca_canalicular", "Transport bile")

steadies <- steadyStates(reactions)
steadies
#>                                                                                    Tca_cyto 
#>                                 "Tca_buffer*import_Tca/(export_Tca_baso + export_Tca_cana)" 
#>                                                                             Tca_canalicular 
#> "Tca_buffer*export_Tca_cana*import_Tca/(transport_Tca*(export_Tca_baso + export_Tca_cana))" 
#>                                                                                  Tca_buffer 
#>                                                                                "Tca_buffer" 

# Parameter transformation that puts the model in steady state
parameters <- getParameters(reactions)
trafo <- repar(eqnvec(setNames(parameters, parameters)), "x <- y",
               x = names(steadies), y = steadies)
trafo
#> Idx           Inner <- Outer
#>   1      Tca_buffer <- Tca_buffer
#>   2 Tca_canalicular <- Tca_buffer*export_Tca_cana*import_Tca/(transport_Tca*(export_Tca_baso+export_Tca_cana))
#>   3        Tca_cyto <- Tca_buffer*import_Tca/(export_Tca_baso+export_Tca_cana)
#>   4 export_Tca_baso <- export_Tca_baso
#>   5 export_Tca_cana <- export_Tca_cana
#>   6      import_Tca <- import_Tca
#>   7   transport_Tca <- transport_Tca
